title: Your ticket
timeZone: All dates and times are in Cairo time.
qrNote: Each passenger has a separate code. Present each passenger’s code to gate staff for ticket verification and boarding.
qrError: The QR image could not be displayed. Keep your booking reference.
unavailableNote: A ticket is available only for a paid, confirmed booking on a trip that has not been cancelled. Open your booking to check its status.
printNote: We check the current ticket status before printing. Print it or save as PDF from your browser’s dialog.
printError: Could not prepare the ticket for printing. Check that the QR code is visible, then try again.
printFromButton: Close the print dialog and use the page’s Print ticket button to check ticket validity and prepare the QR code.
